record.title: Microduck left thigh housing — the 'upper_leg_left' body of Pollen's MJCF: 28 x 47.7 x 61 mm one-sided cup, 1 mm walls, holding the hip-pitch and knee XL330s on axes 42.0 mm apart
record.why: cad/part.py builds one valid solid (bin/cad part:microduck-upper-leg-left, 2026-09-01) and ce-cad/bin/cad-refcheck grades it against Pollen's own published mesh reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/upper_leg_left.stl: p95 surface distance 0.20 mm both ways (mean 0.036 / 0.031, median 0.002), bbox delta [-0.0, 0.001, -0.006] mm, 6/6 holes and bosses matched, 0 unmatched. Round 1 of 1 (out/refcheck/microduck-upper-leg-left/r1). Volume ratio 0.925: the reference's sub-mm inner fillets (rim base, plate-to-wall) are not modelled; every surface is within 0.2 mm at p95.
record.origin_why: modelled by hand in cecad from measurements taken off Pollen Robotics' decimated visual mesh (CC BY-SA-NC sim asset) with cecad.meshslice (plane cuts + ray-cast material intervals, written for this part), cad-mjcf sections and cecad.meshfeatures; nobody has Pollen's CAD and no physical part has been measured. Admitted through the TRIAD.md door: evidence/ledger.jsonl + computed trust.json.
record.why_this_folder_exists: The left thigh of the Microduck: the cup that carries two XL330s between the hip-roll bracket and the shin. Its right-hand twin (part:microduck-upper-leg-right) is measured to be this solid mirrored in x to 0.0000 mm and composes this folder rather than copying it. Nothing on the shelf is a 42 mm two-servo thigh housing.
